The phrase **his companion** is a translation of the standard written Hebrew text in the oldest complete manuscript. There is, however, a correction in the margin of the text that Hebrew scribes have recommended and that represents the reading of some other Hebrew manuscripts. The UST follows this reading. You may want to follow this reading in your translation, or you may want to follow the major translation in your area. Alternate translation: [his companions…his companions]
